name: Fresh Drop
controllingIdea: Every property has a story waiting for the right person to live it.

narrativeArc.incitingIncident: A new property hits the market or is coming soon - a fresh opportunity emerges
narrativeArc.risingAction: Features and details are progressively revealed, building interest and desire
narrativeArc.crisis: Limited time or exclusive opportunity creates urgency
narrativeArc.climax: The 'imagine yourself here' moment - visualizing life in this home
narrativeArc.resolution: Clear path to action - how to see it, make it yours

questions.question: What makes this property special or unique?
questions.purpose: Establish the hook and main selling point
questions.placeholder: It has a chef's kitchen with a 12-foot island and views of the mountains...

questions.question: What are the top 3 features buyers will love?
questions.placeholder: Primary suite with spa bathroom, backyard oasis with pool, gourmet kitchen...

questions.question: Describe the neighborhood and lifestyle it offers.
questions.purpose: Paint the picture of life here
questions.placeholder: Walking distance to downtown, top-rated schools, quiet tree-lined streets...

questions.question: Who is the ideal buyer for this home?
questions.placeholder: Young professionals who want space to entertain, or a growing family...

questions.question: What would you say to someone considering this property?
questions.placeholder: This won't last long in this market - schedule a private showing today...

promptConfig.systemContext: This is a property showcase. The goal is to generate excitement and interest in a new listing. Focus on features that create emotional connection.
promptConfig.toneGuidance: Enthusiastic but not pushy. Let the property speak for itself. Paint a picture of lifestyle, not just features.

slideStructure.contentFocus: How to see it / next steps

avoidPhrases: Act now before it's too late

usageHints: Post when listing goes live or just before for coming soon
Focus on 2-3 standout features, not every detail
Include price point early to qualify viewers

exampleScenarios.title: Modern Farmhouse in Hot Neighborhood
exampleScenarios.situation: New construction in a desirable area with unique design
exampleScenarios.sampleInput: Just listed this incredible modern farmhouse. 4 beds, 3.5 baths, 3200 sqft. The kitchen has a 15-foot island and commercial-grade appliances. Backyard has a covered patio with built-in BBQ. Walking distance to the village.

expectedOutput.hook: Where modern meets farmhouse. And a 15-foot island.
expectedOutput.keyMoment: Mornings at the village. Evenings on that patio.
